scope: Independent primary-method and actual-release review of CN-Buzz2Portfolio and FinTradeBench, followed by a four-track local-data synthesis; recommendation only, no experiment frozen.

decision.immediately_accessible_auxiliary: FinTradeBench 150-question sample for evidence/numerical reasoning diagnostics
decision.reason: The sector benchmark has no verified raw release in this bounded search. The accessible QA sample has expert reasoning labels, not future-return labels or authenticated execution clocks. Do not force a market experiment from either source.
decision.next_step: The cross_track_decision below recommends TraderHarness subject to explicit admission checks. The sectorETF design remains a future extension, not the selected immediate task.

paper.title: CN-Buzz2Portfolio: A Chinese-Market Dataset and Benchmark for LLM-Based Macro and Sector Asset Allocation from Daily Trending Financial News

sources.task: Daily public-attention news passes through compression, perception and allocation; macro and sector portfolios use ETF/feeder-fund proxies. The paper simulates same-day close execution with before-close news and a 1bp fee.
sources.data_description: Four Chinese platforms, daily Top20 lists, 2024 and 2025H1. Raw publication/crawl rows and executable instrument mappings were not available for inspection.

release_evidence.section_1_footnote: Official GitHub link to be updated upon publication
release_evidence.boundary: Bounded exact-name search failure is not proof that no release exists anywhere.

validity_limits: Before-close publication alone does not prove a computed decision can fill at that same close.
Underlying ETF close is a proxy for a feeder-fund transaction, not authenticated realizable execution.
TaskB prose says14 sectors but AppendixB lists15 rows; exact universe needs released authority.
Published narratives and failed memory probes cannot establish causal labels or absence of model-history contamination.
sources.adopt: Market-wide news to fixed sector universe; inspect relevance and measured outcomes separately.
sources.defer: No acquisition or published-score reproduction until raw news, clocks, prices and instrument map are verified.

paper.title: FinTradeBench: A Financial Reasoning Benchmark for LLMs

sources.task: Historically grounded financial QA over SEC fundamentals and OHLCV indicators, with fundamentals/trading/hybrid categories. Expert golden indicators and calibrated judge scores evaluate evidence and reasoning; they do not label subsequent price outcomes.

release_evidence.sample_context_coverage: Public tree includes SEC documents, histories and precomputed contexts for7 tickers; folder name dummy_data denotes sample material, not established synthetic provenance.
release_evidence.full_1400_release: Linked Harvard Dataverse anonymous preview returned HTTP 403 in this environment; full corpus not verified.
release_evidence.unrelated_lookalike: dakshjain-1616/fintradebench-cli is 65 embedded questions, not this paper benchmark.

inspected_code.observation: Computes price indicators and merges fundamentals by quarterly sheet dates; no verified per-fact first-availability clock. Do not reuse precomputed fundamentals as a forward point-in-time feed.

validity_limits: Paper explicitly excludes predictive/live-trading use and acknowledges fiscal-period versus filing-release alignment.
Golden indicators identify needed support; expert/LLM preferred answers are not causal or market-return ground truth.
NASDAQ100 coverage can have large-cap/technology/survivorship selection.
Only sample availability is established here; original price-provider and dataset/code licence scope require separate review before redistribution.
sources.adopt: Auxiliary source-support and arithmetic audit, with gold kept evaluator-side; no API-dependent upstream stack needed.
sources.defer: Do not choose this as the main event-return learning dataset or execute its upstream judge/RAG stack.

admission_gates: Verify downloadable immutable raw evidence, not only a paper release statement or aggregate leaderboard.
Record event/publication/first-availability/acquisition clocks separately; flag estimates and revisions. A fiscal period end is not a filing release.
Map labels to actual tradable instruments, currency, price basis and exchange calendar; keep index/fund proxies explicit.
Choose entry strictly after all admitted evidence and required reasoning can be available; a next-session open is a conservative daily convention, not an observed fill.
Freeze horizon, target, controls, costs and complete target support before inspecting outcome quality.
For sector decisions, include fixed/equal-weight and price-only momentum or regularized controls on identical dates; diversification does not guarantee predictability.
Keep factual reasoning audits separate from return forecasts, simulated execution and causal explanations.

recommended_experiment_if_data_passes.question: Does dated non-price event evidence improve later sector-relative forecasts or fixed-allocation decisions beyond the same price information, and does a retained development lesson add value?
recommended_experiment_if_data_passes.universe: A fixed directly priced sectorETF universe with a declared broad-market reference; otherwise explicitly narrow to a verified single-firm event task instead of relabelling stocks as sectors.
recommended_experiment_if_data_passes.input: Actual pre-entry news/release/filing bytes plus shared trailing prices and numerical state; bounded selection independent of later outcomes.
recommended_experiment_if_data_passes.target: Predeclare post-entry horizon return and benchmark-relative difference; distinguish forecast loss from net portfolio return.
controls: Fixed/equal-weight or cash reference as appropriate
Regularized numerical forecast and training-only calibration
Unchanged-policy repeated draw before attributing small gains to a skill edit
recommended_experiment_if_data_passes.learning: Train/validation/final temporal separation; retain every proposal and failed attempt; new policy frozen before final assessment. Hindsight teacher evidence stays out of forward packets.
recommended_experiment_if_data_passes.claim_limit: One historical experiment cannot establish causal blame, absence of training contamination, general algorithm superiority or profitable live trading.

coordination.root_reviewing: MTBench aligned financial pairs and TraderHarness
coordination.data_scout_reviewing: SEC earnings/events, transcripts and actual price support; docs/data-selection-events.json
coordination.other_reviewed_sources: Existing docs/trading-prior-art.json and docs/finance-validation.md retain earlier method/evaluation reviews.

cross_track_decision.selected_source: TraderHarness A-share six-table release already downloaded and hash-verified
cross_track_decision.basis: Only inspected broad joined panel already on disk. Prefer a bounded multi-session historical forecasting experiment over forcing a tiny or unassembled event corpus.

task.question: On fixed dates and a fixed observed liquid-stock universe, does bounded dated headline evidence improve five-session market-relative return forecasts beyond the same numerical information, and does one retained development skill improve the frozen rich policy?
task.universe: Ten names selected only by observed 2021 liquidity; not a sectorETF universe or a survivorship-complete population.
task.cutoff: Declare a pre-open Asia/Shanghai cutoff and admit only earlier source epochs; past daily bars must be completed before cutoff. Exact cutoff is not frozen here.
task.target: Next eligible exchange-session open to the fifth exchange-session close stock price return minus CSI300 return over identical endpoints. Forecast benchmark only; CSI300 is not an executable hedge.
task.horizon_reason: Five sessions offers a plausible horizon for policy/company-news interpretation beyond next-session noise, without assuming delayed market reaction or causal effects.
task.dates: Use calendar-selected nonoverlapping issue windows with chronological train/validation/later assessment and horizon embargoes. Start no earlier than February 2023 until earlier coverage is repaired; exact date counts remain unfrozen.
task.inputs: Shared price history, state and frozen numerical anchor; rich arm adds bounded timestamp-qualified transformed headlines. Preserve source/redaction tags and deterministic outcome-blind selection.
task.omit: Exclude unknown-vintage fundamentals. Day-only announcement titles require conservative next-session activation or omission; no original full-prose claim.
controls: Training-only regularized numerical forecast and momentum reference
task.learning: One bounded natural-language skill change proposed from training evidence, chosen against unchanged on validation and frozen before later assessment. Shared saved upstream reasoning permits only a conditional downstream-policy comparison; independently rerun price-only versus rich is a whole-pipeline comparison.
task.primary_score: Predeclared squared error of market-relative return point forecasts, averaging fixed targets within issue date then dates equally. Date groups, not stock-date rows, are the primary replication unit.

before_paid_calls: Confirm daily price basis and dividend/split units; either qualify a wealth target correctly or predeclare a restricted action-free price-return task. Do not silently interpret adjusted/raw mixtures as returns.

Verify full fixed exchange-session support for history, entry and horizon for every target and CSI300. A missing stock bar cannot extend the horizon to its fifth observed row. Preserve missing/suspension coverage failures instead of silently scoring favorable subsets.
Freeze the observed universe, dates, price basis, evidence selector, numerical fit period, target, loss and skill-selection rule before inspecting scores.
cross_track_decision.coverage_warning: Actual daily panel has severe September–December 2022 missingness and partial January 2023 coverage; min/max dates do not prove continuous coverage.

alternatives.StockBench: Latest native audit reports 70 nonempty AAPL cache files across 122 civil dates, shifted naive clocks and mismatched filename/publication dates; raw epochs need rejoining and current fundamentals must be omitted.
alternatives.MTBench: Actual pairs contain future-derived labels and some publication-time text with later boilerplate; not an authenticated ready trading corpus.
alternatives.official_macro_and_ETFs: Closest future macro/sector task; seven ETF price panels are verified, but a complete immutable dated release cohort and vintage-aware prior evidence are not assembled.
alternatives.issuer_release_events: Strong primary prose but currently only one independently qualified Apple availability clock; useful development audit, too small for the principal learning comparison.
alternatives.CN_Buzz2Portfolio_and_FinTradeBench: Sector release not verified accessible here; accessible QA labels are reasoning diagnostics, not future-return ground truth.

claim_boundaries: Historical forecast-information and bounded-adaptation feasibility only.
No China trading PnL claim before T+1, suspensions, price limits, corporate actions and execution are validated.
No sectorETF result, causal blame, globally unseen history, causal news effect or live market edge.
Modern model history and transformed headline vintage remain unverified; timestamps qualify metadata, not globally authenticated original knowledge.
